hunks.baseline: “Come at me prepared to die. That’s the only way you’ll manage to tie even a butterfly knot around my wrist.”
hunks.sol: “Come at me ready to die. That’s the only way you’ll manage to tie so much as a butterfly knot around my wrist.”

hunks.baseline: At Choi Byungil’s shout, the Sangdong Guild watchers began charging at me from all directions.
hunks.sol: At Choi Byungil’s shout, the Sangdong Guild watchers charged from every direction.

hunks.baseline: A dagger dropping toward my shoulder was the opening move.
hunks.sol: The opening move was a dagger dropping toward my shoulder.

hunks.baseline: I reached toward the trajectory that looked slow to me.
hunks.sol: I reached toward its trajectory, which looked painfully slow to me.

hunks.baseline: A blade brimming with internal energy shattered the enemy’s dagger. Broken metal and someone’s blood spilled across the nameless weeds.
hunks.sol: The blade, brimming with internal energy, shattered the enemy’s dagger. Shards of metal and someone’s blood sprayed across the nameless weeds.
